stories.title: Trump threatens to blow up Iran's Kharg Island oil hub 'to smithereens'
stories.reason: After Iran retaliated for the US strike near Hormuz by hitting American bases in Jordan, Trump is now threatening the terminal that ships roughly 90% of Iran's oil exports, a major escalation risk.

stories.title: Tim Cook steps down as Apple CEO, hands reins to John Ternus
stories.reason: It's Apple's first CEO transition in 15 years; Cook becomes executive chairman while hardware chief Ternus takes over a company facing intensifying AI competition.

stories.title: Oil climbs above $86 a barrel as Trump's Kharg Island threat raises supply-disruption fears
stories.reason: Analysts say striking Iran's main export hub would be a sharp escalation beyond the tit-for-tat exchanges so far, and markets are already pricing in the risk to global crude supply.

stories.title: House returns from recess to pass funding bill weeks ahead of shutdown deadline
stories.reason: A bipartisan stopgap already passed by the Senate would extend government funding through December 11, and lawmakers are moving early to avoid a shutdown ahead of the November midterms.

stories.title: Anthropic signs out Claude users and wipes payment cards after infostealer malware hijacked login sessions
stories.reason: Malware families including Vidar and RedLine stole session cookies to bypass passwords and 2FA entirely, draining usage limits -- a reminder that AI accounts are now a real target for infostealers.

stories.title: Anthropic previews a hardware standard letting AI agents operate lab robots and microscopes
stories.reason: The Model Hardware Standard would let any AI agent control lab and manufacturing equipment through one shared interface instead of fragmented vendor-specific systems, a step toward AI operating the physical world, not just software.

stories.title: Rescuers still searching for hundreds trapped in Nepal's flooded hydropower tunnels
stories.reason: More than a week after the glacier-collapse flood, roughly 900 workers remain unaccounted for across nine buried tunnels, and officials say Nepal still lacks the equipment to reach many of them.

stories.title: AI-investor-backed group launches multimillion-dollar ad campaign defending data centers
stories.reason: Build American AI, backed by Andreessen Horowitz and OpenAI's Greg Brockman with roughly $50 million on hand, is trying to shift public opinion in battleground states as data centers become a flashpoint ahead of the midterms.
